prompt: Who is the only female artist to have topped Spotify's list of most-streamed artists in three consecutive years (2020–2022)?
answer: No female artist did. **Bad Bunny** topped Spotify’s global most-streamed-artist list for three consecutive years, **2020–2022**. **Taylor Swift** is the only female artist to top the list, doing so in **2023 and 2024**.
